updates.title: Recovered the George Sand clue’s 2022 layout.
updates.body: The same-day archive has 22 lines in the opening letter. The later edit moved its last word from an unmarked even line to a new bold odd line. Both first-word examples match across the archive and current page.

updates.body: Neither reader recognized a reading instruction. A lossless turn clarified the one disputed banknote crop. The original disagreement remains in the review.

updates.body: Both faces of 78/79 show agreed bottom and outer edges. Pages 76/77 show the bottom edge on both faces. Their outer edges remain unresolved. A separate calibration study is needed.

updates.title: The opposite-color readings yielded no instruction.

Reader A had prior ledger exposure beyond the specific predeclaration; Reader B reports a fresh context. Subjective nonrecognition, not a cipher or puzzle exclusion.
